messages:
maria_sec: Quick question — we're proposing increasing infra log retention in the SIEM exports from 90 -> 365 days for compliance. Before we lock this in: who should be able to request full raw exports and what gating (KMS unwrap / approval) do people want?

alex_cheng: +1 on the ask. My vote: exports should require an approved ticket and a scoped service account. No ad-hoc S3 dumps.

sam_oncall: For incident triage we sometimes need quick snapshots. Can we do a two-tier approach: 90d hot retention with self-serve read-only views, 90-365d cold with request-based unwrap? :thinking_face:

lina_pm: Sounds reasonable. Product requirement: auditors and legal need ability to request 365d exports but must be audited and time-boxed. We should provide a request template.

maria_sec: Agreed. Proposal: 
- Self-serve masked views (searchable) for 90d.
- For 90-365d: export package subject to ticket, JIT unwrap via KMS with a 24h access window.
- Exports must include export-audit metadata tag (requestor, ticket, purpose).

alex_cheng: Technical notes: prefer envelope encryption w/ CMK per-tenant for private deployments. For hosted, use CMK with EKM/KMS audit logs. Rotation ok but need to ensure old archives can still be unwrapped (key rotation policy + rewrap?).

maria_sec: Right — we should add a rewrap workflow: when rotating keys, re-encrypt archived bundles with new CMK and record rewrap event in audit log.

sam_oncall: What about temporary access tokens for support? We could generate export tokens scoped to a single export and TTL-limited to 1 hour. CLI example: 
```
redwood export create --scope infra:logs --start 2025-01-01 --end 2025-03-31 --ttl 1h --ticket RD-1234
```
That token only allows retrieval of the pre-encrypted bundle, unwrap still requires KMS approval.

lina_pm: +1. Also include an automated expiration notif to requestor and security team when token is used or expires unused.

alex_cheng: For RBAC changes: introduce a new role `siem_exporter` with permission set: `exports.create`, `exports.view-metadata` (read-only), require `exports.unwrap` as a separate privileged permission that requires MFA + approval.

maria_sec: Good. We'll add an OPA policy gate on `exports.unwrap` that checks: active ticket, approver list, time window, and CMK policy allowlist. Pseudocode: 
```
allow_unwrap = ticket.active && approver.in(group("sec_ops")) && request.ttl <= 24h && cmk in allowlist
```

sam_oncall: One more incident concern: triage may need ephemeral full-text search of older logs without doing a full export. Can we offer a temporary ephemeral search enclave (no download) for 4h? That reduces number of unwraps.

maria_sec: Yes — add ephemeral read-only enclave for triage. Access audited and no copy-out allowed.

sec-bot: Reminder: create RFC and link to policy checklist. Templates: ticket template, export audit metadata schema, CMK rotation checklist.

lina_pm: I'll draft RFC and ticket template. Action items: alex - draft RBAC role + OPA gate; maria - draft unwrap/rewrap playbook and audit fields; sam - prototype ephemeral enclave flow.

alex_cheng: Will do. ETA EOW for RBAC PR.

maria_sec: Thanks all. I'll start a short runbook and share the RFC draft in #eng-security when ready. :thumbsup:
